final_report.executive_summary: This market intelligence brief evaluates the competitive landscape, commercial structures, and architectural paradigms across enterprise AI-powered customer support platforms. Enterprise spend expanded 34% YoY to $4.8B in 2025, driven by the structural transition from deterministic dialog trees to autonomous generative reasoning agents. Commercial models are sharply bifurcated: fixed per-seat add-ons (Zendesk at $50/agent/mo) provide budget predictability, while variable consumption models (Intercom Fin at $0.99/res, Salesforce Agentforce at $2.00/conv) tie spend to deflection volume. Empirical field benchmarking reveals notable divergence between vendor marketing resolution claims (50%) and measured real-world deflection (31%-41%), emphasizing the critical need for human-in-the-loop oversight and rigorous governance.

market_overview.category_definition: AI-powered customer support platforms delivering autonomous multi-channel issue deflection, agent copilots, and intelligent triage.
key_drivers: Shift from rigid dialog-tree bots to LLM reasoning agents grounded in internal documentation.
High enterprise demand for measurable per-resolution ROI and deflection metrics.
Stringent governance mandates for PII redaction and indirect prompt injection defenses.
